newsitem.title: USA: Titan to divest broadband communications.
newsitem.headline: Titan to divest broadband communications.

text.p: The Titan Corp said its first quarter results include a loss from discontinued operations of $343,000, or $0.02 per share, reflecting a plan by Titan to divest its broadband communications business.
For the first quarter of 1996, the loss from discontinued operations was $1,077,000, or $0.07 per share.
It said opportunities for broadband communications business had not developed as fast as expected and it has decided to pursue a spin-off or sale of the business.
Titan earlier reported first quarter net income of $475,000 or $0.02 per share.
